chapter_seo_title: World of Immortality Ch. 594: The Shrunken Heavenly Stele and the Ambush of the Demon City
chapter_meta_description: Xiao Chen battles decaying stone men in Primordial Demon Cities, performs Holy Sacrifice to empower allies, escapes an ambush by the ancient king Meng Degang, and discovers the Heavenly Stele has shrunk to a meter and ended up in a mortal auction house.
og_title: The Shrunken Stele and the Demon City Ambush – World of Immortality Ch. 594
og_description: Xiao Chen confronts decaying stone men, uses the Eight Origin Sounds to shatter a demon city, and performs a Holy Sacrifice to empower the Little Defiant Dragon. He escapes an ambush by the ancient king Meng Degang and later finds the Heavenly Stele has shrunk to a meter and is held by mortals.
twitter_title: Heavenly Stele Shrinks? Xiao Chen Battles Stone Men in Ch. 594
twitter_description: Xiao Chen's quest for Heavenly Marks leads him to battle decaying stone men in Primordial Demon Cities. He performs Holy Sacrifice to boost his allies, escapes an ambush by Meng Degang, and discovers the Heavenly Stele has inexplicably shrunk and ended up at a mortal auction house.
